name: perfpilot-agent
description: 前端性能诊断与自动优化 Agent —— 面向 CI/CD 的前端性能质量门禁

scripts.cycles: madge --circular --extensions ts packages/shared/src packages/adapters/src packages/core/src packages/cli/src
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm cycles && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test:cov
scripts.release:dry: turbo run clean && turbo run build --force && pnpm -r publish --access public --no-git-checks --dry-run
scripts.release: turbo run clean && turbo run build --force && pnpm test && pnpm -r publish --access public --no-git-checks
